claims.statement: Layer0is lowest of40source-validated captured target decoder modules under the declared reported-counter metric, both all-capture and interior subsets.
353.8944TMAC/s per logical device is a conditional nominal ceiling only under applicability and frequency-cap premises.
Selected necessary target INT8work yields a loose conditional compute-only ceiling; no actual achievable maximum is established.

scope.allowed_algorithms: Standard dense target evaluation for initial bounds; alternative algorithm domains require separate proof
scope.fusion_reordering_recomputation: Allowed in relaxed ideal model; candidate semantics must preserve frozen precision contract
scope.sharding_fixed_or_free: State separately; current DP2 TP8 EP16 CP execution does not restrict universal ideal bounds

models.necessary_work_expressions: F8_min, F16_min, Fvec_min, D_HBM_min, D_L2_min, D_link_min, L_causal_min; ideal intermediates not materialized unless proved necessary
models.capacity_upper_expressions: P8_max, P16_max, Pvec_max, B_HBM_max, B_L2_max, B_link_max
models.real_to_relaxed_coverage_argument: Removing scheduling/launch/notification/materialization restrictions only enlarges allowed implementations. Each necessary resource-load lower bound applies to every implementation in the stated algorithm domain. Take max across potentially overlapping resources; sum loads only after shared-resource and nonduplication proof.

relaxations.removed_cost_or_constraint: Launch, Python conversion/notification, avoidable intermediate writes and current fixed barriers are relaxed; memory/communication can overlap computation subject only to separately proved limits.
relaxations.why_optimistic: Does not exclude a legal implementation and does not force whole-operator serialization.

constraints.scope: Declared conventional dense domain and nominal capacity premises
